merged.title: build(port): connect Going Commando to current RAC2 master
merged.author: llesieur99
merged.untrustedBody:
The Going Commando port still read the old `candidates/` layout and `LVL_...FUN_...` names, so it translated none of the current RAC2 matching C. This PR syncs the embedded decompilation to [RAC2 `master` at `86dbd852`](https://github.com/OpenRAC/rac2-gc-decomp/commit/86dbd85236960285e5824b9cc05cde933dfc2bd2) and makes hostgen read `src/`, the level placement catalogue, and the RAC2 overlay relocation range.

The newer source has a file with a function-local signed `extern` followed by an unsigned file-scope declaration of the same symbol. Hostgen now keeps those declarations separate in its prepared copy, preserving the assembler symbol without changing the matching C. Its relocation lowering also respects the upper bound in each game's configuration. Regression tests cover both cases.

Validation on Linux/WSL:
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tools`: 72 passed.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s port/tools/hostgen`: 39 passed.
- `python3 tools/shared.py check`: 16 groups identical.

merged.title: feat(progress): measure the executable's data
merged.author: Veradictus
merged.untrustedBody:
The progress report now carries total_data, matched_data and complete_data, so ByteMatch shows a Data bar for rac1 like it does for dtk projects.

Total is retail's initialised data in SCES_509.16 (core.data, core.rdata, core.lit, .lit, .data and the lvl vtables), 699,072 bytes. Anything still assembled from the dumps in asm/data/ counts as not matched. Matched data is what compiled objects bring themselves: the core_rdata literals in config/core_rodata.txt and the jump tables of decompiled functions. A piece counts when the linked image has retail's bytes at its retail address. Right now that's 34 pieces, 2,568 bytes (0.37%), all exact.

Units get no data measures because the dumps can't be split by unit, and level data isn't measured yet. bss is left out since there are no bytes to compare.

The report commit only adds the data fields. Code numbers are untouched, and gen_progress_report.py --check passes.

merged.title: feat(src): match func_L02_00400CC8
merged.author: ReaperOfVeriod
merged.untrustedBody:
## What

Replaces the `INCLUDE_ASM` marker in `src/levels/02_maktar_nebula/L02_003F5430.c`
with plain C: `func_L02_00400CC8` returns non-zero when the `s16` at `+0xAA` is
`0xB59`, the resident word at `D_0017A80` is `1`, and bit 3 of the byte at `+0x20`
is clear.

The `&&` short-circuit with the trailing ternary is what reproduces retail's
`daddu`/`movn` pair. Letting GCC see the assignment and the test separately folds
the value through the comparison into a constant and emits `sltiu`; a bare
ternary fuses the pair into a single `movz`.

One function added.

merged.title: feat(src): match func_L00_0042D9D0 and func_L00_002D24B8
merged.author: ReaperOfVeriod
merged.untrustedBody:
## What

Two shared functions, so one definition each serves all 27 levels that place them
— 54 placements for two source changes.

**`func_L00_0042D9D0`** clears the pointer the level keeps at `+0x1FC0`. Retail
loads the pointer and zeroes it in the `jr $ra` delay slot, which executes *before*
the return rather than after it:

```
lw $v0, 0x1FC0($a0)
jr $ra
sw $zero, 0x0($v0)     # delay slot
```

**`func_L00_002D24B8`** marks no slot as running and parks the cursor past the end
of the list. Both stores have to go through a single base variable: folding the
constant into each address makes GCC emit an `addiu` per store and a relative
second offset, where retail has one `lui` plus `0xC40` and `0xC48`.

```c
void func_L00_002D24B8(void) {
    char *b = D_00189E20_8;
    *(int *)(b + 0xC40) = -1;
    *(int *)(b + 0xC48) = 0;
}
```

merged.title: build(compiler): opt-in truncation delay-slot split and match func_0012E8C8
merged.author: llesieur99
merged.untrustedBody:
## What

`func_0012E8C8` is a 28-byte libmpeg helper. Its plain C already produced the retail calculation, but the pinned compiler kept `dsll32; dsra32` together as one `truncdisi2` RTL instruction and emitted `jr $ra; nop` after them (32 bytes). Retail places `dsra32` in the return delay slot.

Patch `0057` adds a default-off `-mastra-split-trunc-slot` option that splits this pattern after reload and before delay-slot scheduling. Only the new `src/core/0012E8C8.c` unit enables it through `config/cflags.txt`; the surrounding SDK file and all other translation units keep their existing compiler settings. The compiler source hashes are pinned, and no generated assembly is rewritten. The C definition then matches all 28 retail bytes. The two commits separate compiler behavior from the function match.

The generated progress report and README table are unchanged, per the repository workflow.

merged.title: feat(src): mark the 150 core syscall stubs as handwritten assembly
merged.author: llesieur99
merged.untrustedBody:
## What

Marks the 150 sixteen-byte kernel stubs of `src/core` as `ASM_FUNC` in place of `INCLUDE_ASM`.
Each of them is `addiu $v1,$zero,N ; syscall ; jr $ra ; nop`: the shape the EE kernel library
uses to enter the kernel, and not something a C compiler can emit — no pattern in the EE
backend (`gcc/config/mips`) produces `syscall`, and the plain-C rule leaves no source form that
reaches it. Nothing about them is a matching failure: they were assembly in the original too.

Precedent, both inside and outside this repository:

- rac1-decomp classifies the same stubs as handwritten: `config/handwritten_asm.txt` lists the
  klib ones, and `src/core/00118A40.c` marks 75 of them `ASM_FUNC`.
- this repository already marks two bodies that contain `syscall`: `func_0011B8D8`
  (`src/core/0011B800.c`) and the boot entry `func_00131AE8` (`src/core/00131780.c`).

They sit in 12 files, all under the `src/core/` scope of the coordination comment in #152.

- `tools/build.py all`: **28 pro

opened.title: feat(src): match func_L00_0042D9D0 and func_L00_002D24B8
opened.author: ReaperOfVeriod
opened.untrustedBody:
## What

Two shared functions, so one definition each serves all 27 levels that place them
— 54 placements for two source changes.

**`func_L00_0042D9D0`** clears the pointer the level keeps at `+0x1FC0`. Retail
loads the pointer and zeroes it in the `jr $ra` delay slot, which executes *before*
the return rather than after it:

```
lw $v0, 0x1FC0($a0)
jr $ra
sw $zero, 0x0($v0)     # delay slot
```

**`func_L00_002D24B8`** marks no slot as running and parks the cursor past the end
of the list. Both stores have to go through a single base variable: folding the
constant into each address makes GCC emit an `addiu` per store and a relative
second offset, where retail has one `lui` plus `0xC40` and `0xC48`.

```c
void func_L00_002D24B8(void) {
    char *b = D_00189E20_8;
    *(int *)(b + 0xC40) = -1;
    *(int *)(b + 0xC48) = 0;
}
```

opened.author: llesieur99

Marks the 150 sixteen-byte kernel stubs of `src/core` as `ASM_FUNC` in place of `INCLUDE_ASM`.
